attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Counterspell without waiting on your cast
macros.desc: Drops whatever you’re casting and Counterspells your target right away.
macros.needs: Counterspell learned (24). It cancels your cast even when Counterspell is on cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contrafeitiço
/stopcasting
/cast Contrafeitiço

macros.title: Polymorph the mouseover or your target
macros.desc: Polymorphs the enemy under your cursor and leaves your target alone. With no enemy under the cursor it polymorphs your target.
macros.needs: Polymorph learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Polimorfia
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Polimorfia

macros.title: Arcane Intellect on a friend or yourself
macros.desc: Buffs the friendly unit under your cursor, else your friendly target, else you. Hold Alt to buff yourself no matter what.

keys.text: Buff your mouseover, friendly target or yourself

macros.needs: Arcane Intellect learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Intelecto Arcano
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Intelecto Arcano

macros.title: Dampen or Amplify Magic on a friend
macros.desc: Dampen Magic on the friend under your cursor, your friendly target or yourself. Shift swaps to Amplify Magic.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Amplify Magic; Dampen Magic
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Amplify Magic; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Dampen Magic

keys.text: Dampen Magic on your mouseover, friendly target or yourself
Amplify Magic on the same units

macros.needs: Dampen Magic (12) and Amplify Magic (18) learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Amplificar Magia; Atenuar Magia
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Amplificar Magia; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Atenuar Magia

macros.title: Remove Lesser Curse on a friend or yourself
macros.desc: Decurses your mouseover, friendly target or you. Shift decurses you straight away.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Remove Lesser Curse
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Remove Lesser Curse

keys.text: Decurse your mouseover, friendly target or yourself

macros.needs: Remove Lesser Curse learned (18). Forever’s version also removes a Bane.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Remover Maldição Inferior
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Remover Maldição Inferior

macros.title: Conjure water, or food with Shift
macros.desc: One button conjures your top rank of water. Hold Shift for food instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Conjure Food; Conjure Water
/cast [mod:shift] Conjure Food; Conjure Water
macros.needs: Conjure Water and Conjure Food learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Conjurar Comida; Conjurar Água
/cast [mod:shift] Conjurar Comida; Conjurar Água

macros.title: Use whichever mana gem you have
macros.desc: Tries Mana Ruby, Citrine, Jade and Agate in that order. Press it when you need mana.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use Mana Ruby
/use Mana Citrine
/use Mana Jade
/use Mana Agate
macros.needs: A conjured mana gem in your bags. The item names are the Classic ones.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use Mana Ruby
/use Mana Citrine
/use Mana Jade
/use Mana Agate

macros.title: Ice Armor, Mage Armor or Frost Armor
macros.desc: Ice Armor by default, Shift for Mage Armor and Ctrl for Frost Armor. Only one armor can be up at a time.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Mage Armor; [mod:ctrl] Frost Armor; Ice Armor
/cast [mod:shift] Mage Armor; [mod:ctrl] Frost Armor; Ice Armor
macros.needs: Ice Armor (30) and Mage Armor (34). Frost Armor covers the levels before that.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Armadura de Mago; [mod:ctrl] Armadura Gélida; Armadura de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Armadura de Mago; [mod:ctrl] Armadura Gélida; Armadura de Gelo

macros.title: Alliance teleports on one key
macros.desc: Teleports you to Stormwind. Shift goes to Ironforge, Ctrl to Darnassus and Alt to Dalaran.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Teleport: Ironforge; [mod:ctrl] Teleport: Darnassus; [mod:alt] Teleport: Dalaran; Teleport: Stormwind
macros.needs: The teleport spells you want (20 and 30). Teleport: Dalaran is new in Forever and comes at 50.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Teleporte: Altaforja; [mod:ctrl] Teleporte: Darnassus; [mod:alt] Teleporte: Dalaran; Teleporte: Ventobravo

macros.title: Horde teleports on one key
macros.desc: Teleports you to Orgrimmar. Shift goes to Undercity, Ctrl to Thunder Bluff and Alt to Dalaran.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Teleport: Undercity; [mod:ctrl] Teleport: Thunder Bluff; [mod:alt] Teleport: Dalaran; Teleport: Orgrimmar
macros.needs: The teleport spells you want (20 and 30). Teleport: Dalaran is new in Forever and comes at 50.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Teleporte: Cidade Baixa; [mod:ctrl] Teleporte: Penhasco do Trovão; [mod:alt] Teleporte: Dalaran; Teleporte: Orgrimmar

macros.title: Alliance portals on one key
macros.desc: Opens a portal to Stormwind. Shift makes it Ironforge and Ctrl makes it Darnassus.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Portal: Ironforge; [mod:ctrl] Portal: Darnassus; Portal: Stormwind
macros.needs: The portal spells you want (40, and 50 for Darnassus)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Portal: Altaforja; [mod:ctrl] Portal: Darnassus; Portal: Ventobravo

macros.title: Horde portals on one key
macros.desc: Opens a portal to Orgrimmar. Shift makes it Undercity and Ctrl makes it Thunder Bluff.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Portal: Undercity; [mod:ctrl] Portal: Thunder Bluff; Portal: Orgrimmar
macros.needs: The portal spells you want (40, and 50 for Thunder Bluff)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Portal: Cidade Baixa; [mod:ctrl] Portal: Penhasco do Trovão; Portal: Orgrimmar

macros.title: Slow Fall, Shift to cancel
macros.desc: Dismount and cast Slow Fall on yourself. Hold Shift to remove the effect when you're back on the ground.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Slow Fall
/dismount [nomod:shift]
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Slow Fall
/cast [nomod:shift,@player] Slow Fall
macros.needs: Slow Fall learned; a Light Feather
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Queda Lenta
/dismount [nomod:shift]
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Queda Lenta
/cast [nomod:shift,@player] Queda Lenta

macros.title: Intellect, Shift for Arcane Brilliance
macros.desc: Buff one friend with Arcane Intellect, or hold Shift for Arcane Brilliance. Both choose your friendly mouseover, target or yourself.
macros.needs: Arcane Brilliance learned; Arcane Powder for the group buff
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Inteligência Arcana; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Intelecto Arcano

macros.title: Protect Arcane Missiles channel
macros.desc: Repeated presses won’t restart a channel you’re already in.
macros.needs: Arcane Missiles learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Mísseis Arcanos
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Mísseis Arcanos

macros.title: Arcane Blast, with Missiles and Frostbolt on modifiers
macros.desc: Arcane Blast on the button, Shift for Arcane Missiles and Ctrl for a cheaper Frostbolt when the stack gets expensive. Nothing fires while you’re channeling Missiles.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Blast
/cast [mod:shift,nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Arcane Missiles; [mod:ctrl,nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Frostbolt; [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Arcane Blast

keys.text: Cast Arcane Missiles while your Blast stacks are up
Cast Frostbolt as a cheaper filler

macros.needs: Arcane Blast talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto Arcano
/cast [mod:shift,nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Mísseis Arcanos; [mod:ctrl,nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Seta de Gelo; [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Three Blasts, then Missiles
macros.desc: Each press moves along the sequence: three Arcane Blasts, then Arcane Missiles while the stacks last (18 seconds from the first Blast). It starts over after 10 seconds or a new target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Blast
/castsequence [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] reset=10/target Arcane Blast, Arcane Blast, Arcane Blast, Arcane Missiles
macros.needs: Arcane Blast talent and Arcane Missiles. Stop early if mana is short, because each stack adds 100% to Blast’s cost.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto Arcano
/castsequence [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] reset=10/target Impacto Arcano, Impacto Arcano, Impacto Arcano, Mísseis Arcanos

macros.title: Grab the nearest enemy and Arcane Blast
macros.desc: Clears a dead or friendly target, picks the nearest enemy if you have none, then opens with Arcane Blast.
macros.needs: Arcane Blast talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto Arcano
/cleartarget [dead][help]
/targetenemy [noexists]
/cast [harm,nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Trinkets and Arcane Power, then Blast
macros.desc: Pops both trinkets and Arcane Power, then starts an Arcane Blast. Arcane Power makes your spells cost 30% more mana for 15 sec.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Blast
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Arcane Power
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Arcane Blast
macros.needs: Arcane Power and Arcane Blast talents
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto Arcano
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Poder Arcano
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Arcane Blast, with a mana gem on Shift
macros.desc: Arcane Blast on the button. Hold Shift to use a mana gem first; the gem is instant, so the cast still starts on the same press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Blast
/use [mod:shift] Mana Ruby
/use [mod:shift] Mana Citrine
/use [mod:shift] Mana Jade
/use [mod:shift] Mana Agate
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Arcane Blast

keys.text: Use a mana gem, then cast Arcane Blast

macros.needs: Arcane Blast talent and a conjured mana gem. The item names are the Classic ones.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto Arcano
/use [mod:shift] Mana Ruby
/use [mod:shift] Mana Citrine
/use [mod:shift] Mana Jade
/use [mod:shift] Mana Agate
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Arcane Explosion, rank 1 out of combat
macros.desc: Top rank once you’re in a fight and rank 1 before it, so an opening pull costs less mana.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Explosion
/cast [combat] Arcane Explosion; Arcane Explosion(Rank 1)
macros.needs: Arcane Explosion learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Explosão Arcana
/cast [combat] Explosão Arcana; Explosão Arcana(Grau 1)

macros.title: Conjure any mana gem on one key
macros.desc: Conjures a Mana Ruby by default. Shift makes a Citrine, Ctrl a Jade and Alt an Agate.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Conjure Mana Citrine; [mod:ctrl] Conjure Mana Jade; [mod:alt] Conjure Mana Agate; Conjure Mana Ruby
macros.needs: Each gem spell learned: Agate at 28, Jade at 38, Citrine at 48 and Ruby at 58
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Conjurar Citrino de Mana; [mod:ctrl] Conjurar Jade de Mana; [mod:alt] Conjurar Ágata de Mana; Conjurar Rubi de Mana

macros.title: Wand that doesn’t toggle off
macros.desc: Starts your wand and keeps it going if you press the button again.
macros.needs: A wand equipped
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Atirar
/cast !Atirar

macros.title: Evocation, Shift to stop
macros.desc: Start Evocation without cutting it short on repeated presses. Hold Shift to stop the channel when you need to move or cast something else.

keys.text: Start Evocation without restarting an active channel

macros.needs: Evocation learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Evocação
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/stopmacro [mod:shift]
/cast [nochanneling:Evocation] Evocação

macros.title: Fireball or Scorch
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Scorch when you need a shorter cast.
macros.needs: Scorch learned (22)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Calcinar; Bola de Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Calcinar; Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Immediate Fire Blast
macros.desc: Cancels your current cast for an instant Fire Blast.
macros.needs: Fire Blast learned; this cancels your current cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto de Fogo
/stopcasting
/cast Impacto de Fogo

macros.title: Grab the nearest enemy and Fireball
macros.desc: Clears a dead or friendly target, picks the nearest enemy if you have none, then casts Fireball at it.
macros.needs: Fireball learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bola de Fogo
/cleartarget [dead][help]
/targetenemy [noexists]
/cast [harm] Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Pyroblast to open, Fireball after
macros.desc: Out of combat the button casts Pyroblast as a long-range opener. Once you’re in the fight it casts Fireball.
macros.needs: Pyroblast talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Ignimpacto; Bola de Fogo
/cast [nocombat] Ignimpacto; Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Fireball, with Pyroblast and Fire Blast on modifiers
macros.desc: Fireball on the button. Shift casts Pyroblast once Heating Up has shortened it, and Ctrl casts an instant Fire Blast while you move.
macros.needs: Heating Up and Pyroblast talents
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bola de Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Ignimpacto; [mod:ctrl] Impacto de Fogo; Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Trinkets and Combustion, then Fireball
macros.desc: Uses both trinkets, pops Combustion and starts a Fireball. Hold Shift for Scorch instead. Combustion lasts for three non-periodic Fire crits.
macros.needs: Combustion talent (40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Combustão
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Combustão
/cast [mod:shift] Calcinar; Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Flamestrike, rank 1 on Shift
macros.desc: Casts your top Flamestrike, or rank 1 with Shift to save mana, then you click the ground. Forever allows only one active Flamestrike per mage.
macros.needs: Flamestrike learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Flamejante
/cast [mod:shift] Golpe Flamejante(Grau 1); Golpe Flamejante

macros.title: Fireball, with Frostfire Bolt for kiting
macros.desc: Fireball on the button. Shift casts Frostfire Bolt, which slows the target by 40% and can help build Heating Up.
macros.needs: Frostfire Bolt, which the trainer teaches at 40; Heating Up talent for its Pyroblast benefit
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Bola de Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Seta de Fogofrio; Bola de Fogo

macros.title: Immediate Blast Wave
macros.desc: Cancels your current cast and blasts everything close, dazing it for 6 sec.
macros.needs: Blast Wave talent; this cancels your current cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda de Impacto
/stopcasting
/cast Onda de Impacto

macros.title: Quick slow or full Frostbolt
macros.desc: Hold Shift to cast rank 1 for a cheaper slow; press normally for your highest rank.
macros.needs: Frostbolt learned; rank syntax uses the English client
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Seta de Gelo(Grau 1); Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Immediate Frost Nova
macros.desc: Cancels your current cast to freeze enemies in melee range.
macros.needs: Frost Nova learned; this cancels your current cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nova Congelante
/stopcasting
/cast Nova Congelante

macros.title: Grab the nearest enemy and Frostbolt
macros.desc: Clears a dead or friendly target, picks the nearest enemy if you have none, then casts Frostbolt at it.
macros.needs: Frostbolt learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/cleartarget [dead][help]
/targetenemy [noexists]
/cast [harm] Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Frost Nova, then Ice Lance
macros.desc: The first press freezes nearby enemies. A second press within 6 seconds throws Ice Lance at the frozen target. Give Ice Lance its own key too, since this one waits on Nova’s cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Frost Nova
/stopcasting
/castsequence reset=6/target Frost Nova, Ice Lance
macros.needs: Ice Lance talent; this cancels your current cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nova Congelante
/stopcasting
/castsequence reset=6/target Nova Congelante, Lança de Gelo

macros.title: Ice Lance, Fire Blast and Cone of Cold on one key
macros.desc: Ice Lance on the button, or Fire Blast with Shift when the target isn’t frozen; the two share an 8 sec cooldown. Ctrl casts a Cone of Cold slow.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Ice Lance
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Fire Blast; [mod:ctrl] Cone of Cold; Ice Lance
macros.needs: Ice Lance talent; Cone of Cold learned (26). This cancels your current cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lança de Gelo
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Impacto de Fogo; [mod:ctrl] Cone de Frio; Lança de Gelo

macros.title: Blizzard, rank 1 on Shift
macros.desc: Casts your top Blizzard, or rank 1 with Shift to save mana, then you click the ground.
macros.needs: Blizzard learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nevasca
/cast [mod:shift] Nevasca(Grau 1); Nevasca

macros.title: Frostbolt, with trinkets on Shift
macros.desc: Frostbolt on the button. Hold Shift to use both trinkets as you cast.

keys.text: Use both trinkets, then cast Frostbolt

macros.needs: Frostbolt learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/use [mod:shift] 13
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Ice Armor, then Arcane Intellect
macros.desc: Press once for Ice Armor and again within 10 seconds for Arcane Intellect, both on yourself.
macros.needs: Ice Armor (30) and Arcane Intellect learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [@player] reset=10 Armadura de Gelo, Intelecto Arcano

macros.title: Counterspell your target, mouseover or a follow-up
macros.desc: Cancels your cast and Ice Block, then Counterspells your target. Shift hits the mouseover and Ctrl starts a Frostbolt right after.

keys.text: Counterspell your target, then start a Frostbolt

macros.needs: Counterspell learned (24). It cancels your cast even when Counterspell is on cooldown. Counterspell is off the global cooldown, so the Frostbolt line can follow it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contrafeitiço
/stopcasting
/cancelaura Bloco de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Contrafeitiço
/cast [mod:ctrl] Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Polymorph the mouseover or target, rank 1 on Shift
macros.desc: Cancels your cast and polymorphs the enemy under your cursor, or your target. Shift casts rank 1, which costs less mana and lasts a shorter time.

keys.text: Polymorph your mouseover, or your target
Cast Polymorph rank 1 on the same enemy

macros.needs: Polymorph learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Polimorfia
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Polimorfia(Grau 1); [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Polimorfia

macros.title: Sheep a second enemy and jump back
macros.desc: Tab to a second enemy, press this to sheep it, and you’re back on your first target right away.
macros.needs: Polymorph learned, and a previous target to return to
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Polimorfia
/stopcasting
/cast [harm,nodead] Polimorfia
/targetlasttarget

macros.title: Sheep them, then Evocation
macros.desc: First press sheeps your target. The second starts Evocation while they wander, so you get your mana back in a long duel. A new target or 20 sec idle starts it over.
macros.needs: Polymorph and Evocation (20) learned. Any damage on the sheep wakes it, and Evocation has an 8 min cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/20 Polimorfia, Evocação

macros.title: Frost Nova, Cone of Cold and Blast Wave peel
macros.desc: Dismounts, cancels your cast and Ice Block, then casts Frost Nova rank 1, which costs less and hits for far less (damage can break the freeze). Shift is Cone of Cold and Ctrl is Blast Wave.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Frost Nova
/stopcasting
/dismount
/cancelaura Ice Block
/cast [mod:shift] Cone of Cold; [mod:ctrl] Blast Wave; Frost Nova(Rank 1)
macros.needs: Frost Nova learned; Cone of Cold (26); Blast Wave talent for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nova Congelante
/stopcasting
/dismount
/cancelaura Bloco de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Cone de Frio; [mod:ctrl] Onda de Impacto; Nova Congelante(Grau 1)

macros.title: Blink, racial escape, trinkets and Free Action Potion
macros.desc: Dismounts, cancels your cast and Blinks. Shift uses your racial escape instead, Ctrl adds both trinkets to the Blink and Alt adds a Free Action Potion.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Blink
/stopcasting
/dismount
/use [mod:ctrl] 13
/use [mod:ctrl] 14
/use [mod:alt] Free Action Potion
/cast [mod:shift] Will to Survive
/cast [mod:shift] Escape Artist
/cast [mod:shift] Will of the Forsaken
/cast [nomod:shift] Blink

keys.text: Drink a Free Action Potion, then Blink

macros.needs: Blink learned (20). The racial lines only work for Humans (Will to Survive), Gnomes (Escape Artist) and Undead (Will of the Forsaken).
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lampejo
/stopcasting
/dismount
/use [mod:ctrl] 13
/use [mod:ctrl] 14
/use [mod:alt] Poção de Ação Desimpedida
/cast [mod:shift] Desejo de Sobreviver
/cast [mod:shift] Artista da Fuga
/cast [mod:shift] Determinação dos Renegados
/cast [nomod:shift] Lampejo

macros.title: Frost Nova, then Blink on the next press
macros.desc: First press drops your cast and freezes everything next to you. Turn away and press again to Blink clear. After 8 sec without a press it starts over on Nova.
macros.needs: Frost Nova and Blink (20) learned. The sequence waits on Nova’s cooldown, so keep a plain Blink key as well.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/dismount
/castsequence reset=8 Nova Congelante, Lampejo

macros.title: Mana Shield, Ice Barrier and both Wards on one key
macros.desc: Cancels your cast and shields up. Mana Shield on the button, Shift for Ice Barrier, Ctrl for Frost Ward and Alt for Fire Ward.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Ice Barrier; [mod:ctrl] Frost Ward; [mod:alt] Fire Ward; Mana Shield
macros.needs: Mana Shield (20), Fire Ward (20), Frost Ward (22) and the Ice Barrier talent (40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Barreira de Gelo; [mod:ctrl] Proteção contra Gelo; [mod:alt] Proteção contra Fogo; Escudo de Mana

macros.title: Frostbolt the mouseover to slow it
macros.desc: Frostbolts the enemy under your cursor, or your target if none is there. Shift casts rank 1, which is cheaper and gives a shorter slow.

keys.text: Frostbolt your mouseover, or your target
Cast Frostbolt rank 1 on the same enemy

macros.needs: Frostbolt learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Seta de Gelo(Grau 1); [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Fire Blast or Ice Lance on the mouseover
macros.desc: Cancels your cast for an instant Fire Blast on the enemy under your cursor, or your target. Shift throws Ice Lance instead, the better hit on a frozen target. The two share an 8 sec cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Fire Blast
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Ice Lance; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Fire Blast

keys.text: Fire Blast your mouseover, or your target
Ice Lance your mouseover, or your target

macros.needs: Fire Blast learned; Ice Lance talent for Shift. This cancels your current cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Impacto de Fogo
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Lança de Gelo; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Impacto de Fogo

macros.title: Swap schools after a Counterspell lockout
macros.desc: Frostbolt on the button. If an enemy Counterspell locks Frost, Shift casts Fireball and Ctrl casts Arcane Missiles.
macros.needs: Frostbolt, Fireball and Arcane Missiles learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Bola de Fogo; [mod:ctrl] Mísseis Arcanos; Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Decurse a friend or Counterspell an enemy under the cursor
macros.desc: Cancels your cast, then decurses the friend under your cursor or Counterspells the enemy there. With nothing under the cursor it uses your target. Shift decurses you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead] Remove Lesser Curse; [@mouseover,harm,nodead] Counterspell; [help,nodead] Remove Lesser Curse; [harm,nodead] Counterspell

keys.text: Decurse a friendly mouseover or target, or Counterspell an enemy one

macros.needs: Remove Lesser Curse (18) and Counterspell (24) learned. This cancels your current cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead] Remover Maldição Inferior; [@mouseover,harm,nodead] Contrafeitiço; [help,nodead] Remover Maldição Inferior; [harm,nodead] Contrafeitiço

macros.title: Trinkets on one key
macros.desc: Uses your top trinket, Shift uses the bottom one and Ctrl uses both.
macros.needs: Trinkets equipped in both slots
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [nomod][mod:ctrl] 13
/use [mod:shift][mod:ctrl] 14

macros.title: Trinkets and your racial burst on one key
macros.desc: Uses both trinkets and Berserking, Blood Fury or Eureka!, whichever your race has. Press it just before your burst so everything lines up.
macros.needs: Trolls (Berserking), Orcs (Blood Fury) and Gnomes (Eureka!) get something from the racial lines. Other races only get the trinkets.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Berserk
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Eureca!

macros.title: Presence of Mind plus an instant spell
macros.desc: Uses Presence of Mind and casts one spell instantly. Arcane Blast by default, Shift for Pyroblast, Ctrl for Polymorph and Alt for Frostbolt.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Presence of Mind
/stopcasting
/cast Presence of Mind
/cast [mod:shift] Pyroblast; [mod:ctrl] Polymorph; [mod:alt] Frostbolt; Arcane Blast
macros.needs: Presence of Mind talent. Arcane Blast and Pyroblast need their own talents; Polymorph and Frostbolt don’t.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Presença de Espírito
/stopcasting
/cast Presença de Espírito
/cast [mod:shift] Ignimpacto; [mod:ctrl] Polimorfia; [mod:alt] Seta de Gelo; Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Trinkets, Arcane Power and Presence of Mind burst
macros.desc: Uses both trinkets, Arcane Power and Presence of Mind, then casts an instant Pyroblast. Hold Shift for Frostbolt if you don’t have Pyroblast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Pyroblast
/stopcasting
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Arcane Power
/cast Presence of Mind
/cast [mod:shift] Frostbolt; Pyroblast
macros.needs: Arcane Power and Presence of Mind talents (Arcane), plus the Pyroblast talent (Fire) for the default cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ignimpacto
/stopcasting
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Poder Arcano
/cast Presença de Espírito
/cast [mod:shift] Seta de Gelo; Ignimpacto

macros.title: Counterspell, then an instant sheep
macros.desc: Counterspells the enemy under your cursor, or your target, then uses Presence of Mind to sheep the same enemy instantly. Good on a healer mid-cast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Polymorph
/stopcasting
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Counterspell
/cast Presence of Mind
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Polymorph
macros.needs: Presence of Mind talent and Counterspell (24). With Presence of Mind on cooldown the sheep is a normal cast. If you cut a cast you’d only just started, press again.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Polimorfia
/stopcasting
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Contrafeitiço
/cast Presença de Espírito
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Polimorfia

macros.title: Instant Arcane Wrath, with Arcane Power on Shift
macros.desc: Presence of Mind turns your next Arcane Wrath into an instant hit. Shift also fires both trinkets and Arcane Power. It hits hardest after a few Arcane Blasts.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Wrath
/stopcasting
/use [mod:shift] 13
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast [mod:shift] Arcane Power
/cast Presence of Mind
/cast Arcane Wrath

keys.text: Presence of Mind, then instant Arcane Wrath
Trinkets and Arcane Power too, then instant Arcane Wrath

macros.needs: Presence of Mind and Arcane Wrath (25) talents, plus Arcane Power for Shift. All three are in the Arcane tree.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ira Arcana
/stopcasting
/use [mod:shift] 13
/use [mod:shift] 14
/cast [mod:shift] Poder Arcano
/cast Presença de Espírito
/cast Ira Arcana

macros.title: Counterspell, then Arcane Wrath inside the silence
macros.desc: Counterspells your target and starts Arcane Wrath straight away. With both ranks of Improved Counterspell they’re silenced for 4 sec, longer than Wrath’s 3.5 sec cast.
macros.needs: Improved Counterspell and Arcane Wrath (25) talents; Counterspell (24). A silence doesn’t stop melee interrupts such as Kick or Pummel.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contrafeitiço
/stopcasting
/cast Contrafeitiço
/cast Ira Arcana

macros.title: Mana Shield, with a mana gem on Shift
macros.desc: Cancels your cast and puts up Mana Shield. Hold Shift to use a mana gem first, since the shield drains mana with every hit it soaks.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mana Shield
/stopcasting
/use [mod:shift] Mana Ruby
/use [mod:shift] Mana Citrine
/use [mod:shift] Mana Jade
/use [mod:shift] Mana Agate
/cast Mana Shield

keys.text: Use a mana gem, then cast Mana Shield

macros.needs: Mana Shield (20), and a conjured gem for Shift. Arcane Shielding cuts the mana each point of damage costs by a third. The item names are the Classic ones.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Escudo de Mana
/stopcasting
/use [mod:shift] Mana Ruby
/use [mod:shift] Mana Citrine
/use [mod:shift] Mana Jade
/use [mod:shift] Mana Agate
/cast Escudo de Mana

macros.title: Arcane Missiles for a Missile Barrage proc
macros.desc: When Missile Barrage lights up, this drops your Fireball or Frostbolt and fires the quick, free Missiles at the enemy under your cursor, or your target. Mashing it won’t restart the channel.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Arcane Missiles
/stopcasting [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles]
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Arcane Missiles
macros.needs: Missile Barrage talent. A cast you started less than 1.5 sec ago still holds the global cooldown, so the Missiles wait for it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Mísseis Arcanos
/stopcasting [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles]
/cast [nochanneling:Arcane Missiles,@mouseover,harm,nodead][nochanneling:Arcane Missiles] Mísseis Arcanos

macros.title: Arcane Wrath to open, Arcane Blast after
macros.desc: Out of combat the button casts Arcane Wrath, your biggest Arcane hit, on someone who hasn’t seen you yet. Once you’re fighting it casts Arcane Blast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Arcane Wrath; Arcane Blast
/cast [nocombat] Arcane Wrath; Arcane Blast
macros.needs: Arcane Wrath (25) and Arcane Blast talents. Keep Wrath on its own key too, for its 6 sec cooldown mid-fight.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Ira Arcana; Impacto Arcano
/cast [nocombat] Ira Arcana; Impacto Arcano

macros.title: Sheep, Pyroblast, then Fire Blast
macros.desc: A 1v1 opener: press once to sheep your target, again to hard-cast Pyroblast on the sheep, and once more for Fire Blast as it lands. A new target or 20 sec idle starts it over.
macros.needs: Pyroblast talent. A sheep heals fast, so don’t wait long before the Pyroblast. If Fire Blast is cooling down, the last step waits for it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/20 Polimorfia, Ignimpacto, Impacto de Fogo

macros.title: Dismount into a Pyroblast opener with trinkets
macros.desc: Out of combat, one press takes you off your mount, fires both trinkets and starts Pyroblast on your target. Once you’re fighting, the same key is Fire Blast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Pyroblast; Fire Blast
/dismount
/use [nocombat] 13
/use [nocombat] 14
/cast [nocombat] Pyroblast; Fire Blast
macros.needs: Pyroblast talent; on-use trinkets for the trinket lines
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Ignimpacto; Impacto de Fogo
/dismount
/use [nocombat] 13
/use [nocombat] 14
/cast [nocombat] Ignimpacto; Impacto de Fogo

macros.title: Fire Blast, then a faster Pyroblast
macros.desc: First press is Fire Blast, which adds a Heating Up stack when it hits (two on a crit), so the Pyroblast on the next press casts at least 25% faster. Hold Shift to add Combustion.

keys.text: Fire Blast, then Pyroblast on the next press

macros.needs: Heating Up and Pyroblast talents; Combustion (40) for Shift. While Fire Blast is cooling down the first press does nothing.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Combustão
/castsequence reset=target/10 Impacto de Fogo, Ignimpacto

macros.title: Frost Nova, then Pyroblast while they’re rooted
macros.desc: First press freezes everything next to you. Step out of melee range and press again to hard-cast Pyroblast before the freeze ends. It resets after 8 sec.
macros.needs: Pyroblast talent. Nova holds for up to 8 sec and a full Pyroblast takes 6, so Heating Up stacks give you room. It won’t cancel a cast you’re in the middle of.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=8 Nova Congelante, Ignimpacto

macros.title: Blast Wave, then Blink
macros.desc: First press drops your cast and Blast Waves everyone close, dazing them to half speed for 6 sec. Turn away and press again to Blink. Handy when Frost Nova is down.
macros.needs: Blast Wave talent (30) and Blink (20). The sequence waits on Blast Wave’s cooldown and resets after 6 sec.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/dismount
/castsequence reset=6 Onda de Impacto, Lampejo

macros.title: Frostfire Bolt the mouseover, rank 1 Frostbolt on Shift
macros.desc: Frostfire Bolts the enemy under your cursor, or your target, leaving a burn and a slow. Shift casts rank 1 Frostbolt instead, a 1.5 sec cast, when you need the slow sooner.

keys.text: Frostfire Bolt your mouseover, or your target
Frostbolt rank 1 on the same enemy

macros.needs: Frostfire Bolt, which the trainer teaches at 40. Frostfire Bolt crits also build Heating Up.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Fogofrio
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Seta de Gelo(Grau 1); [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Seta de Fogofrio

macros.title: Ice Block toggle with Cold Snap on Shift
macros.desc: Casts Ice Block, and a second press drops it early. Shift casts Cold Snap to finish your Frost cooldowns, so the next press can Block again.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cold Snap; Ice Block
/stopcasting
/cancelaura Ice Block
/cast [mod:shift] Cold Snap; Ice Block

keys.text: Cast Ice Block, or cancel it if it is up
Cancel Ice Block if it is up, then cast Cold Snap

macros.needs: Ice Block and Cold Snap talents. While Ice Block is on cooldown, the second press only cancels the aura.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Ruptura do Gelo; Bloco de Gelo
/stopcasting
/cancelaura Bloco de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Ruptura do Gelo; Bloco de Gelo

macros.title: Frostbolt to slow, Cone of Cold when they close
macros.desc: Frostbolts the enemy under your cursor, or your target. Shift casts rank 1, a 1.5 sec cast with a shorter slow. Ctrl drops your cast for Cone of Cold, which your Winter’s Chill stacks make hit harder.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Frostbolt
/stopcasting [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:ctrl] Cone of Cold; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Frostbolt(Rank 1); [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Frostbolt

keys.text: Frostbolt your mouseover, or your target
Frostbolt rank 1 on the same enemy
Stop casting, then Cone of Cold

macros.needs: Cone of Cold (26) for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Seta de Gelo
/stopcasting [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:ctrl] Cone de Frio; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Seta de Gelo(Grau 1); [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Seta de Gelo

macros.title: Frost Nova, Frostbolt and Cone of Cold shatter
macros.desc: Press once to freeze them and take a step back, then press for Frostbolt and again for Cone of Cold. Each gets Shatter’s crit bonus while they stay frozen. A new target or 8 sec idle resets it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/8 Frost Nova, Frostbolt, Cone of Cold
macros.needs: Shatter talent for the crits; Cone of Cold (26). Damage can break Frost Nova early, and the Frostbolt’s Winter’s Chill stack adds to the Cone.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/8 Nova Congelante, Seta de Gelo, Cone de Frio

macros.title: Cold Snap into a second Frost Nova or Ice Barrier
macros.desc: Drops your cast for Frost Nova. Once Nova or Ice Barrier is on cooldown, Shift uses Cold Snap and Novas again, and Ctrl uses Cold Snap and puts Ice Barrier back up.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift][mod:ctrl] Cold Snap
/cast [mod:ctrl] Ice Barrier; Frost Nova
macros.needs: Cold Snap talent; Ice Barrier talent (40) for Ctrl. Cold Snap has a 10 min cooldown and resets all your Frost spells, Ice Block included.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift][mod:ctrl] Ruptura do Gelo
/cast [mod:ctrl] Barreira de Gelo; Nova Congelante

macros.title: Leave Ice Block with Blink, Ice Barrier or Ice Lance
macros.desc: Cancels Ice Block and Blinks away. Shift comes out with Ice Barrier instead, and Ctrl with an Ice Lance at your target. If only the Block drops, press again.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cancelaura Ice Block
/cast [mod:shift] Ice Barrier; [mod:ctrl] Ice Lance; Blink

keys.text: Cancel Ice Block, then Ice Barrier
Cancel Ice Block, then Ice Lance your target

macros.needs: Ice Block talent; Ice Barrier (40) and Ice Lance talents for the modifiers. The spell after the cancel sometimes needs that second press.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cancelaura Bloco de Gelo
/cast [mod:shift] Barreira de Gelo; [mod:ctrl] Lança de Gelo; Lampejo

macros.title: Frostbolt, then Ice Lance as it lands
macros.desc: On a frozen target, press once for Frostbolt and again just before it lands for Ice Lance, so both hit while the freeze holds. A new target or 4 sec idle resets it.
macros.needs: Ice Lance talent. Frost Nova, Frostbite or Fingers of Frost gives you the freeze, and Ice Lance hits a frozen target much harder. Its 8 sec cooldown is shared with Fire Blast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=target/4 Seta de Gelo, Lança de Gelo

macros.title: Cone of Cold, then Blink
macros.desc: First press drops your cast and Cones everyone in front of you. Turn away and press again to Blink while they’re slowed. Use it when Frost Nova is on cooldown.
macros.needs: Cone of Cold (26) and Blink (20). The sequence waits on Cone of Cold’s cooldown and resets after 6 sec.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/dismount
/castsequence reset=6 Cone de Frio, Lampejo
